title: NexusMED UCI/Hospital Drug Dosing Engine V2 - REAL DOSING CORE
scope: Adult hospital/ICU core. Numeric rules intended for deterministic CDS, not autonomous prescribing.
important_limitations: This is a verified P0/core library, not every medication in the hospital formulary.
UCSF CRRT recommendations generally assume CVVHD with effluent about 2 L/h unless a drug-specific effluent table is stated.
Institutional concentrations, compatibility, maximum peripheral concentrations and local formulary rules must be configured separately.
Critical illness changes PK/PD; dynamic renal function, obesity, burns, ECMO and unusual MICs may require TDM/specialist review.
global_hard_stops: No mg/kg dose without a documented weight and explicit weight scalar (TBW/IBW/AdjBW).
Do not use eGFR alone when a source specifies Cockcroft-Gault CrCl.
Unstable AKI: fixed renal-bin dosing is provisional; force renal reassessment and pharmacist/ID/ICU review.
RRT is not equivalent to CrCl <10. Require IHD vs SLED/PIRRT vs CVVH/CVVHD/CVVHDF and, when relevant, effluent rate.
Never infer a missing RRT dose by halving a non-dialysis dose.
TMP/SMX weight dosing is by TMP component unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Liposomal amphotericin B and amphotericin B deoxycholate are different formulations; never interchange mg/kg rules.
Daptomycin must not be selected for pneumonia.
Vancomycin serious MRSA should use AUC-guided workflow (target AUC24/MIC 400-600 when MIC=1), not trough-only finalization.
Neuromuscular blockers require sedation/analgesia and ventilatory support.
For beta-lactam extended infusion, use only a validated drug-specific regimen; do not generalize duration/dose across the class.
If required inputs are missing or the rule context does not match the indication/population, return SPECIALIST_REVIEW rather than fabricate a number.

drugs.dose_rule: Non-CNS HSV: CrCl >50: 5 mg/kg IV q8h; 25-50: q12h; 10-25: q24h; <10: 2.5 mg/kg q24h. HSV encephalitis/disseminated VZV: 10 mg/kg q8h, q12h, q24h, then 5 mg/kg q24h in same renal strata.
drugs.renal_rule: Use TBW; if TBW >120% IBW use AdjBW. Renal strata are part of dose rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: non-CNS 2.5 mg/kg IV now then qPM; CNS/VZV 5 mg/kg now then qPM. CRRT/CVVHD: non-CNS 5 mg/kg q24h; CNS/VZV 10 mg/kg q12h.
drugs.monitoring: SCr, urine output, neurotoxicity; ensure hydration as clinically appropriate.
drugs.hard_stops: Do not calculate mg/kg without a documented weight and weight scalar.

drugs.dose_rule: Extended interval, other infections: CrCl >=60: 15 mg/kg IV q24h; 40-59: q36h; 21-39: q48h; <=20: use conventional/TDM rather than automatic extended interval.
drugs.renal_rule: Weight-based; renal interval adjustment shown in dose rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD/CRRT: require modality-specific aminoglycoside protocol plus levels; do not infer from CrCl <10.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Obtain random level 6-14 h after dose for extended-interval nomogram when protocol applies.
drugs.monitoring: Drug levels, SCr, urine output, vestibular/auditory toxicity. Pneumonia conventional peak target example 25-35 mg/L; trough <5 mg/L in UCSF table.
drugs.hard_stops: No automatic extended-interval dosing if CrCl <=20, unstable renal function, or population excluded by local nomogram.

drugs.dose_rule: Cryptococcal meningitis: 4 mg/kg IV q24h with flucytosine when indicated. Other invasive fungal infection: 5 mg/kg IV q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose adjustment in UCSF dosing table; toxicity monitoring remains mandatory.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD/CRRT: same dose; no dialysis adjustment in UCSF table.
drugs.monitoring: SCr, K, Mg, hepatic tests, infusion reactions.
drugs.hard_stops: FORMULATION HARD STOP: liposomal amphotericin B doses are not interchangeable with amphotericin B deoxycholate.

drugs.dose_rule: UTI/other lower-intensity: >50: 2 g IV q6h; 30-49: q8h; 15-29: q12h; <15: q24h. Other serious infections: >50: 2 g q4h; 30-49: q6h; 15-29: q8h; <15: q12h.
drugs.renal_rule: Use CrCl strata in dose rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use dedicated IHD/CRRT rule from current institutional table; never substitute <15 rule for RRT.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard: CrCl >30: 3 g IV q6h; 15-30: 3 g q12h; <15: 3 g q24h. CRAB high-dose extended-infusion strategy in UCSF: CrCl >60: 9 g IV q8h over 4 h; lower renal function requires ID/pharmacy-specific adjustment.
drugs.renal_rule: Standard renal strata shown; high-dose CRAB renal adjustment should be protocol-driven.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT: use dedicated table/protocol; do not infer high-dose CRAB regimen in RRT.
drugs.critical_care_rule: High-dose 9 g q8h over 4 h is indication-specific, not a universal ICU dose.

drugs.dose_rule: CAP including ICU: 500 mg IV/PO q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment in UCSF table.
drugs.rrt_rule: No RRT adjustment in core table.

drugs.dose_rule: >50: 2 g IV q8h; 10-50: 2 g q12h; <10: 1 g q12h. In selected meningitis/ARC/resistant GNR combination scenarios, 2 g q6h may be considered with specialist oversight.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal intervals shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current IHD/CRRT table.
drugs.hard_stops: Do not automatically select q6h merely because patient is in ICU; require indication/ARC/specialist rule.

drugs.dose_rule: Uncomplicated GP: CrCl >30: 1 g IV q8h; 10-29: 1 g q12h; <10: 1 g q24h. Complicated GP/GN: >30: 2 g q8h; 10-29: 2 g q12h; <10: 1 g q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 2 g IV now/post-HD; stable schedule can use 2 g/2 g/3 g post-HD. CRRT/CVVHD: 2 g IV q12h.

drugs.dose_rule: Severe infection/Pseudomonas/febrile neutropenia/meningitis: CrCl >60: 2 g IV q8h; 30-60: 2 g q12h; 10-29: 2 g q24h; <10: 1 g q24h. Non-severe: 2 g q12h, 2 g q24h, 1 g q24h, 500 mg q24h respectively.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown; reassess frequently in AKI recovery.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 2 g x1 now/post-HD (alternative 1 g now then qPM in UCSF). CRRT/CVVHD: 1 g q8h; extended infusion may be used per protocol.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Extended-infusion option: load 2 g over 30 min; >60: 2 g q8h over 4 h; 30-60: 2 g q12h over 4 h; <30 use short-infusion regimen in UCSF protocol.
drugs.monitoring: SCr and neurologic status; cefepime neurotoxicity risk increases with accumulation.

drugs.dose_rule: CrCl >120: 2 g IV q6h over 3 h; 60-119: 2 g q8h; 30-59: 1.5 g q8h; 15-29: 1 g q8h; <15: 750 mg q12h; all over 3 h.
drugs.renal_rule: Explicit ARC-like >120 mL/min stratum is included.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 750 mg q12h over 3 h. CRRT by effluent: <=2 L/h: 1.5 g q12h; 2.1-3: 2 g q12h; 3.1-4: 1.5 g q8h; >4: 2 g q8h.
drugs.hard_stops: CRRT dose requires effluent rate; do not default to a single CRRT dose.

drugs.dose_rule: Severe/MRSA pneumonia: CrCl >50: 600 mg IV q8h; 30-50: 400 mg q8h; 15-30: 300 mg q8h; <15: 200 mg q8h. Lower-risk SSTI/CAP uses same renal amounts q12h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current IHD/CRRT table if RRT.

drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current IHD/CRRT table.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Extended infusion option: load 2 g; >50: 2 g q8h over 4 h; 31-50: q12h over 4 h; <31 use short infusion per UCSF.

drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown; re-evaluate daily if renal function changes.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use dedicated RRT table.
drugs.monitoring: Renal function; microbiology/MIC and resistance mechanism.

drugs.dose_rule: cUTI: CrCl >50: 1.5 g IV q8h; 30-50: 750 mg q8h; 15-29: 375 mg q8h. Pneumonia/severe infection: >50: 3 g q8h; 30-50: 1.5 g q8h; 15-29: 750 mg q8h. Infuse over 3 h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use dedicated RRT table/protocol.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard serious infection: 2 g IV q24h. UTI: 1 g q24h. Meningitis or enterococcal endocarditis combination regimen: 2 g q12h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment in UCSF table.
drugs.rrt_rule: No routine dialysis adjustment in core rule; verify combined severe renal/hepatic dysfunction separately.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard: CrCl >50 or 30-50: 400 mg IV q12h or 500 mg PO q12h; <30: 400 mg IV q24h or 500 mg PO q24h. Pseudomonas/GNR BSI: >50: 400 mg IV q8h or 750 mg PO q12h; 30-50: 400 mg IV q12h or 500 mg PO q12h; <30: 400 mg IV q24h or 500 mg PO q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 400 mg IV qPM or 500 mg PO qPM. CRRT: 400 mg IV q8h or 500 mg PO q12h.

drugs.dose_rule: Uncomplicated: 600 mg IV q8h or 450 mg PO q8h. Necrotizing fasciitis/GAS toxin-suppression context: 900 mg IV q8h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment.
drugs.rrt_rule: No IHD adjustment.

drugs.dose_rule: Serious infection: CrCl >30: 8-10 mg/kg IV q24h; CrCl <=30: q48h. Selected VRE infections may use up to 12 mg/kg with specialist/TDM strategy.
drugs.renal_rule: Interval adjustment at CrCl <=30.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use RRT-specific protocol/current table.
drugs.monitoring: CPK at baseline and at least weekly; renal function; symptoms of myopathy.
drugs.hard_stops: HARD STOP: do not use daptomycin to treat pneumonia.

drugs.dose_rule: 100 mg IV/PO q12h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment.
drugs.rrt_rule: No RRT adjustment in core dosing.

drugs.dose_rule: CrCl >30: 1 g IV q24h; <=30: 500 mg IV q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal reduction shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 500 mg now then qPM, or selected post-HD strategy 500 mg-1 g post-HD. CRRT: 1 g q24h.

drugs.dose_rule: Severe systemic infection target maintenance by weight in UCSF: <=80 kg 400 mg q24h; 81-100 kg 600 mg q24h; >100 kg 800 mg q24h; loading depends on indication.
drugs.renal_rule: CrCl 10-50: 50% of target maintenance; <10: 25% of target maintenance in UCSF table.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use dedicated IHD/CRRT dosing table; post-HD timing matters.
drugs.monitoring: QT, hepatic tests, interactions; organism/species/MIC.

drugs.renal_rule: Renal interval adjustment shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current RRT table plus levels.
drugs.monitoring: CBC, hepatic tests, renal function, serum levels when available.
drugs.hard_stops: If calculated single dose >2 g, flag pharmacist/ID review per institutional guidance.

drugs.dose_rule: Treatment: CrCl >70: 5 mg/kg q12h; 50-69: 2.5 mg/kg q12h; 25-49: 2.5 mg/kg q24h; 10-24: 1.25 mg/kg q24h. Prophylaxis: >70: 5 mg/kg q24h; 50-69: 2.5 mg/kg q24h; 25-49: 1.25 mg/kg q24h; 10-24: 0.625 mg/kg q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use RRT-specific table.
drugs.monitoring: CBC with differential, SCr.

drugs.dose_rule: Extended interval, other infections: CrCl >=60: 7 mg/kg IV q24h; 40-59: q36h; 21-39: q48h; <=20: conventional/TDM.
drugs.renal_rule: Interval adjustment shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD/CRRT require modality-specific protocol and levels.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Random level 6-14 h after dose for applicable nomogram.
drugs.monitoring: Drug levels, SCr, auditory/vestibular toxicity. Conventional example pneumonia peak 8-10 mg/L, trough <1 mg/L.

drugs.dose_rule: Serious GN/Nocardia: CrCl >60: 500 mg IV q6h; 30-60: 250 mg q6h; 15-30: 250 mg q8h; <15: alternative/specialist regimen. NTM example: 1000 mg q12h, 500 mg q12h, 250 mg q12h by same first 3 renal strata.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use RRT-specific table.
drugs.monitoring: Renal function and neurotoxicity/seizure risk.

drugs.dose_rule: 372 mg isavuconazonium IV/PO q8h for 6 doses (48 h), then 372 mg q24h. 372 mg prodrug corresponds to 200 mg isavuconazole.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment in UCSF table.
drugs.rrt_rule: No IHD adjustment.
drugs.monitoring: LFTs, interactions; QT-shortening context.

drugs.dose_rule: Other severe infection/GNR BSI: CrCl >50: 750 mg q24h; 20-49: 750 mg q48h; <20: 750 mg x1 then 500 mg q48h. UTI: >50: 500 mg q24h; 20-49: 500 mg x1 then 250 mg q24h; <20: 500 mg x1 then 250 mg q48h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal adjustment shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD severe/pneumonia: 750 mg x1 then 500 mg q48h. CRRT severe: 750 mg x1 then 500 mg q24h.

drugs.dose_rule: 600 mg IV/PO q12h. Mycobacterial regimens may use 600 mg q24h under specialist protocol.
drugs.renal_rule: No routine renal adjustment; in stable CrCl <30 and courses >10 d, some experts consider 300 mg BID after 72 h with TDM.
drugs.rrt_rule: No IHD adjustment; 600 mg q12h in current UCSF RRT table.
drugs.monitoring: CBC, neuropathy with prolonged course, serotonergic interactions; consider TDM.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard: CrCl >50: 1 g IV q8h; 26-50: 1 g q12h; 10-25: 500 mg q12h; <10: 500 mg q24h. Meningitis/CF: 2 g q8h, 2 g q12h, 1 g q12h, 1 g q24h respectively.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strata shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: standard 500 mg now then qPM; meningitis/CF 1 g now then qPM. CRRT/CVVHD: standard 1 g q8h; meningitis/CF 2 g q12h. If CVVHD >2 L/h, specialist/pharmacy review.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Selected extended infusion: load 1 g over 30 min; CrCl >50 standard 1 g q8h over 3 h, 26-50 q12h over 3 h; meningitis/CF 2 g q8h or q12h over 3 h. Do not encode 2 g q8h as universal shock dose.
drugs.monitoring: Renal function, MIC/organism; beta-lactam TDM if available in high-risk critical illness.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard: CrCl >10: 500 mg IV/PO q8h; <10: 500 mg q12h. Intra-abdominal infection: 500 mg q12h regardless of these strata in UCSF table.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal adjustment shown for standard indication.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current RRT table if dialysis.

drugs.dose_rule: Candidemia/invasive candidiasis or empiric ICU therapy: 100 mg IV q24h. Endocarditis/device infection/esophageal candidiasis: 150 mg q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal or hepatic dose adjustment in UCSF table.
drugs.rrt_rule: No dialysis adjustment in core rule.

drugs.dose_rule: Load 200 mg IV/PO x1 then 100 mg q12h. Selected resistant-infection high-dose strategy: 200 mg q12h under specialist protocol.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment in UCSF core rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: Use current RRT guidance if needed.

drugs.dose_rule: Extended infusion preferred in UCSF if eligible: CrCl >20: load 4.5 g IV over 30 min x1, then 4.5 g over 4 h q8h starting immediately after load. If <20, use short infusion. Short infusion: non-Pseudomonas >50 3.375 g q6h; 10-50 q8h; <10 2.25 g q8h. Pseudomonas: CrCl >20 4.5 g q6h; <20 3.375 g q8h.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal strategies shown.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: 2.25 g IV q8h short infusion. CRRT/CVVHD: load 4.5 g then 4.5 g over 4 h q8h.
drugs.monitoring: Renal function, sodium load, microbiology/MIC.

drugs.dose_rule: 300 mg IV/PO q12h x2 doses on day 1, then 300 mg q24h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose adjustment; avoid IV formulation if possible when CrCl <50 because of IV vehicle, per UCSF note.
drugs.rrt_rule: No HD dose adjustment in current UCSF table.
drugs.monitoring: TDM when indicated, LFTs, QT, interactions.

drugs.dose_rule: Standard: 100 mg IV load then 50 mg q12h. Severe hepatic impairment: 100 mg load then 25 mg q12h. Selected severe resistant infections may use 200 mg load then 100 mg q12h under ID protocol.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal adjustment.
drugs.rrt_rule: No dialysis adjustment in core rule.
drugs.monitoring: LFTs, nausea; indication-specific mortality signal considerations.

drugs.dose_rule: Dose MUST be expressed by trimethoprim (TMP). SSTI/UTI: CrCl >30 1 DS tab q12h; 15-30 1 DS q24h; <15 1 SS q24h. Bone/joint: 8 mg TMP/kg/day -> 4 -> 2 by renal strata >30, 15-30, <15. Systemic GNR/Nocardia/Stenotrophomonas: 10 -> 5 -> 2.5 mg TMP/kg/day. PCP/CNS: 15 -> 7.5 -> 5 mg TMP/kg/day.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal reductions embedded above. DS = 160 mg TMP/800 mg SMX; SS = 80/400.
drugs.rrt_rule: IHD: SSTI/UTI 1 SS now then qPM; systemic GNR 2.5 mg TMP/kg now/qPM; PCP 5 mg TMP/kg now/qPM. CRRT: SSTI 1 DS q12h; systemic GNR 10 mg TMP/kg/day; PCP 15 mg TMP/kg/day.
drugs.monitoring: K, SCr, CBC, interactions.
drugs.hard_stops: HARD STOP: never calculate mg/kg from the sulfamethoxazole component when the protocol specifies TMP.

drugs.dose_rule: Serious infection: loading 20-25 mg/kg IV using appropriate body-weight rule; maintenance individualized to AUC. UCSF example nomogram: CrCl >90, complicated age <65: <60 kg 750 mg q8h; 60-80 kg 1 g q8h; 81-100 kg 1.25 g q8h; >100 kg 1.5 g q8h. CrCl 50-90 uses same weight bands q12h; CrCl 15-49 q24h. CrCl <15 not on dialysis: 10-15 mg/kg x1 then level-driven.
drugs.renal_rule: AUC-guided dosing preferred for serious MRSA; do not rely on trough-only target.
drugs.rrt_rule: CRRT: load 20-25 mg/kg x1, then 10-15 mg/kg q24h with AUC/levels. IHD: load 20-25 mg/kg x1, then commonly 500 mg post-HD only in UCSF nomogram with levels.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Target AUC24/MIC 400-600 mg*h/L for serious MRSA assuming MIC 1 mg/L; target early (24-48 h) when feasible.
drugs.monitoring: AUC/Bayesian levels, SCr, urine output; re-estimate with renal change.
drugs.hard_stops: HARD STOP: serious MRSA dosing must not be finalized from trough alone when AUC workflow is available.

drugs.dose_rule: Treatment: 6 mg/kg IV q12h x2 doses, then 4 mg/kg IV q12h; oral maintenance according to formulation/weight/indication.
drugs.renal_rule: No dose reduction for renal function itself; manufacturer cautions about IV vehicle (SBECD) in renal impairment; use oral when appropriate.
drugs.rrt_rule: No HD dose adjustment in current UCSF table.
drugs.monitoring: TDM, LFTs, QT, visual/neurotoxicity, interactions. In obesity use institutional AdjBW protocol.

drugs.dose_rule: 200 mg IV x1 on day 1, then 100 mg IV q24h for indicated course.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose adjustment in current UCSF dosing table, including severe renal impairment; assess formulation/vehicle and current label/local policy.
drugs.rrt_rule: Same standard regimen in IHD/CRRT in UCSF table.
drugs.monitoring: LFTs; indication and treatment window.

drugs.dose_rule: Acute hypotension label: start 8-12 mcg/min IV, then titrate; typical maintenance 2-4 mcg/min.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose table; titrate to hemodynamic endpoint.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not dictate a fixed dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: SSC 2026: first-line vasopressor in septic shock.
drugs.monitoring: Continuous hemodynamics/ECG; frequent BP; assess perfusion and extravasation.
drugs.hard_stops: Do not convert mcg/min to mcg/kg/min without explicit institutional protocol and documented weight.

drugs.dose_rule: Septic shock label: 0.01-0.07 units/min IV. Post-cardiotomy shock: 0.03-0.1 units/min.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose table; titrate within indication-specific range.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not dictate fixed dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: SSC 2026 suggests adding vasopressin when norepinephrine dose is escalating.
drugs.monitoring: MAP, heart rate, sodium, ischemia, cardiac output/perfusion.

drugs.dose_rule: Septic shock hypotension: 0.05-2 mcg/kg/min IV, titrated to desired BP; wean gradually.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose table; titrate clinically.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not dictate fixed dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: SSC 2026: add when MAP remains inadequate despite norepinephrine + vasopressin; can be used when vasopressin unavailable.
drugs.monitoring: MAP, ECG, lactate interpreted with epinephrine effect, glucose, perfusion.

drugs.dose_rule: Vasodilatory shock continuous infusion: 0.5-6 mcg/kg/min IV. Perioperative infusion: 0.5-1.4 mcg/kg/min; bolus 50-250 mcg for perioperative hypotension.
drugs.renal_rule: No fixed renal reduction; titrate.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not dictate fixed dose.
drugs.monitoring: BP, heart rate, peripheral perfusion.
drugs.hard_stops: Do not use perioperative bolus rule as a septic-shock infusion rule.

drugs.dose_rule: Typical IV infusion 2.5-15 mcg/kg/min; rare doses up to 40 mcg/kg/min in labeling/clinical use.
drugs.renal_rule: No fixed renal reduction; titrate to cardiac output/perfusion.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not dictate a fixed dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: SSC 2026: in septic shock with cardiac dysfunction and persistent hypoperfusion, use dobutamine added to norepinephrine or epinephrine alone as an inotropic strategy.
drugs.monitoring: ECG, HR, BP, perfusion, cardiac output when available.

drugs.dose_rule: Load 50 mcg/kg IV over 10 min when appropriate; maintenance 0.375-0.75 mcg/kg/min.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal maintenance examples: CrCl 5: 0.20; 10: 0.23; 20: 0.28; 30: 0.33; 40: 0.38; 50: 0.43 mcg/kg/min.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT: require pharmacy/ICU protocol because clearance depends on modality/residual kidney function.
drugs.monitoring: BP, arrhythmias, renal function, electrolytes.

drugs.dose_rule: ICU sedation: start 5 mcg/kg/min; increase by 5-10 mcg/kg/min at intervals of at least 5 min to clinical effect; typical maintenance 5-50 mcg/kg/min. Avoid exceeding 4 mg/kg/h (about 67 mcg/kg/min) unless benefits outweigh risks.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dose table; titrate effect.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not define dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: Use sedation target (e.g., RASS) and daily reassessment. PADIS 2025 conditionally favors dexmedetomidine over propofol when light sedation/delirium reduction are highest priorities.
drugs.monitoring: RASS, BP, triglycerides, CK/lactate/acid-base if PRIS concern, calories.
drugs.hard_stops: Hard warning when >4 mg/kg/h; require override reason.

drugs.dose_rule: ICU initiation: 1 mcg/kg over 10 min; loading may be omitted when converting from another sedative. Maintenance 0.2-0.7 mcg/kg/h.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal reduction specified; consider dose reduction in hepatic impairment and age >65.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not define dose.
drugs.critical_care_rule: PADIS 2025 suggests dexmedetomidine over propofol when light sedation and/or delirium reduction are highest priorities.
drugs.monitoring: RASS, bradycardia, hypotension.

drugs.dose_rule: If loading required for continuous ICU sedation: 0.01-0.05 mg/kg IV slowly, repeat q10-15 min as needed. Initial maintenance infusion 0.02-0.10 mg/kg/h, titrated to lowest effective rate.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal dysfunction can increase active metabolite accumulation; no simple CrCl table in this core rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not guarantee removal of parent/metabolites; titrate and reassess.
drugs.monitoring: RASS, respiratory/hemodynamic status, accumulation/delirium risk.

drugs.dose_rule: IV induction: 1-4.5 mg/kg over about 60 sec; commonly 1-2 mg/kg at approximately 0.5 mg/kg/min within labeling.
drugs.renal_rule: No fixed renal reduction in this core rule.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not define dose.
drugs.monitoring: BP, HR, airway/secretions, emergence reactions.
drugs.hard_stops: Do not reuse induction dose as an analgesic/sedation infusion dose; separate protocols required.

drugs.dose_rule: Adult induction: 0.2-0.6 mg/kg IV; usual 0.3 mg/kg over 30-60 sec.
drugs.renal_rule: No renal dosing table for single induction dose.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT not relevant to single induction dose.
drugs.monitoring: Hemodynamics; myoclonus; adrenal suppression context.
drugs.hard_stops: RSI/induction-only rule; not a maintenance sedative.

drugs.dose_rule: Intubation: 0.6 mg/kg IV. Rapid-sequence intubation: 0.6-1.2 mg/kg. Maintenance bolus 0.1-0.2 mg/kg. Continuous infusion may start around 10-12 mcg/kg/min after evidence of recovery, then titrate to TOF/clinical need.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal/hepatic dysfunction may prolong effect; titrate neuromuscular monitoring rather than fixed renal table.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not define a fixed dose.
drugs.monitoring: TOF, ventilation, depth of sedation/analgesia.
drugs.hard_stops: HARD STOP: neuromuscular blockade requires adequate sedation/analgesia and ventilatory support.

drugs.dose_rule: Status epilepticus load: 15-20 mg PE/kg IV at 100-150 mg PE/min; maximum administration rate 150 mg PE/min. Maintenance: 4-6 mg PE/kg/day divided.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal failure/hypoalbuminemia alter protein binding; use free phenytoin interpretation/clinical pharmacy when relevant.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT-specific level interpretation required.
drugs.monitoring: Continuous ECG/BP/respiration during loading; phenytoin/free levels.
drugs.hard_stops: Units are mg PE (phenytoin equivalents), not mg fosphenytoin mass.

drugs.dose_rule: Start 5 mg/h IV; increase by 2.5 mg/h every 5 min for rapid titration or every 15 min for gradual titration; maximum 15 mg/h. If hypotension/tachycardia occurs, stop and may restart at 3-5 mg/h after stabilization.
drugs.renal_rule: No CrCl-based titration table; titrate BP.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT does not define dose.
drugs.monitoring: Continuous BP/HR; IV site.

drugs.dose_rule: Edema: initial 20-40 mg IV/IM; may repeat or increase after 2 h based on response. Acute pulmonary edema: 40 mg IV slowly; if inadequate, 80 mg IV after 1 h. For high-dose IV administration, rate should not exceed 4 mg/min.
drugs.renal_rule: Renal impairment often requires higher threshold doses, but no universal CrCl-to-dose table; titrate to urine/output endpoint.
drugs.rrt_rule: RRT: if anuric with no residual kidney function, diuretic response is not expected; do not auto-dose based on CRRT alone.
drugs.monitoring: Urine output, Na/K/Mg, BP, renal function, ototoxicity risk with rapid/high doses.

claude_contract.source_of_truth: This JSON/deterministic rule engine; the LLM is not the dosing source of truth.
algorithm: Return dose + rationale + source IDs + verification date
claude_contract.if_no_exact_match: Return SPECIALIST_REVIEW and list missing/mismatched inputs. Never invent a dose.
